verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs describe two ways to send outbound webhooks: alerts can route to any HTTP endpoint via webhook, and automation rules can trigger webhooks. Together these let a programmatic consumer subscribe to platform events. missing for 10: a documented webhook payload schema and catalog of event types, delivery guarantees (retries, signing or verification), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
